disclaimer: These measurements are development-machine reference measurements used to validate the E5 benchmark methodology. They are not the final target-hardware E5 evidence and do not establish deployment suitability.

resource.cpu_scope: total user CPU time consumed during the measured pass only
resource.peak_rss_unit_note: ru_maxrss is BYTES on macOS (not kilobytes as on Linux)
resource.peak_rss_scope: peak RSS for process lifetime, not per-iteration
resource.instrumentation_note: Latency measured per-iteration inside the timed loop (time.perf_counter_ns); resource probes (CPU, memory) are bookend measurements around the entire measured loop — no resource probe is inside the timed loop.
